```{python}
import hqfbp
```

## Optmized Headers

Conceptually header could be thought as Json but with a compact encoding.

```json
{  
  "Message-Id": 42,
  "Src-Callsign": "FOSM-1",
  "Content-Type": "text/plain;charset=UTF-8",
  "File-Size": 8
}
```

```{python}
packed = hqfbp.pack({
    "Message-Id": 42,
    "Src-Callsign": "FOSM-1",
    "Content-Type": "text/plain;charset=UTF-8",
    "File-Size": 8,
}, b"")
print(packed.hex(' '))
print("#bytes:", len(packed))
```
